allow:
Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
feat\(admin\): upgrade Nuxt 3.14 to Nuxt 4.2

- Upgrade nuxt from ^3.14.0 to ^4.2.2
- Upgrade @nuxt/ui from ^3.0.0 to ^4.3.0
- Upgrade @vueuse/nuxt from ^12.0.0 to ^14.1.0
- Add @nuxtjs/color-mode ^4.0.0 \(required by @nuxt/ui 4.x\)
- Add @tiptap/vue-3 ^3.15.3
- Add @vueuse/core ^14.1.0
- Add srcDir: ''.'' to keep Nuxt 3 directory structure
- Update compatibilityDate to 2025-01-01
- Remove deprecated ui.icons config

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
feat\(admin\): localize fonts using @fontsource packages

- Add @fontsource/inter and @fontsource/jetbrains-mono for local fonts
- Disable all remote font providers \(google, bunny, fontshare, fontsource\)
- Add session configuration for nuxt-auth-utils cookie settings

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
fix\(admin\): disable @nuxt/fonts module to prevent remote requests

- Set ui.fonts: false to disable @nuxt/fonts module
- Fonts are loaded via CSS imports from @fontsource packages instead
- Fixes Google Fonts connection errors in restricted network environments

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
docs: update CLAUDE.md for Nuxt 4.2 upgrade

- Update tech stack: Nuxt 3.14 → 4.2, @nuxt/ui 3.0 → 4.x
- Add @fontsource for local fonts
- Add common errors: Google Fonts, Session, WSL native binding
- Add font configuration section

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
